_comment: Loop Mode config — THE single bring-up seam. Edit this one file, then run /ship-watch-start. Everything machine- or org-specific lives here. A request/response Ship ignores this file entirely; it is only read once Loop Mode is invoked. See loop.config.example.json for a fully-filled reference and README 'Enabling Loop Mode'.
_ship_root_note: "." = the directory you launch /ship-watch-start from (must be the ship root). Set an absolute path here if you ever launch from elsewhere.
